meera: Quick bring-up for new candidate 'tanager-quant6' on embeddings. Ran recall@k, centroid checks, and short-query stress on dev_holdout_6k.

dave: TL;DR numbers?

meera: Baseline (tanager-v2) recall@10 = 0.801. tanager-quant6 = 0.788 (delta -0.013). recall@100 = 0.902 -> 0.898 (tiny). Paired bootstrap p=0.018.

olga: Any obvious slices where it falls off?

meera: Yep 2% of failures concentrated in symbol-rich queries (code, math), and 30% in very short queries (<=3 tokens).
Example failing query: "std::map::erase" 50k sample id 186342.

pranav: Did you check norm/bias shift and nearest-neighbor churn?

meera: Mean norm -3.8% vs baseline. Mean intra-cluster cosine 0.69 -> 0.65. NN churn (top5) ~12% of queries.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for tanager-quant6 on 5% traffic next Tue 02:00UTC with auto-revert if recall@10 drop > 2.5%.

dave: Try per-channel quant + asymmetric zero-point and a small output-scale tweak. Last time that helped code-like queries.

olga: Also try tiny L2 renormalize after quantization: x = x / max(1, 0.99*||x||) — keeps long vectors stable.

meera: Kicked off per-channel + asymmetric + post-L2 norm sweep. Repro script:```bash
./holdout_eval.sh --model tanager-quant6 --holdout dev_holdout_6k --k 10,100 --resamples 1000 --save-samples --slices short,code_sym
```

pranav: Add UMAP + topic-wise neighbor-diff visuals to the artifact bundle. We want to inspect topic smear.

meera: Will upload UMAP + top-200 failed sample IDs. Quick pilot: applying a +1.03 norm multiplier recovered recall@10 to 0.795. Per-channel run still running.

dave: If per-channel + norm recovers >80% of gap and latency impact <2%, acceptable for canary. If not, consider hybrid 6-to-5-bit fallback for low-cost traffic, keep baseline for short queries.

meera: Plan: 1) finish per-channel sweep; 2) run 5-bit ablation on same holdout; 3) prepare short-query routing rule for canary (<4 tokens -> baseline). Posting numbers when done. :thumbsup:

olga: Also tag QA for manual review of sample ids; sometimes human read reveals tokenization edge-case.

meera: Noted. Artifact link will be s3://redwood-artifacts/6491239876/ (UMAP + samples + run logs).

pranav: :eyes: Thanks, sounds like a solid plan.

meera: Posting final sweep in ~90m.
